title: kate-ui: show an open or save failure
summary: remember_effect stores the file_effect_line sentence on the window. render draws that sentence under the editor. Ready clears the sentence. The test runs on macOS.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The test builds only on macOS. The change stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Import file_effect_line from crate::files. Add notice: Option<String> to WindowRoot and set notice: None in open. Add fn remember_effect. It sets the slot to file_effect_line(effect).map(str::to_string). apply_request, save_active, and on_close_file call remember_effect(&mut self.notice, &effect) with the FileEffect they already receive. save_active does this before the NeedsPath return. on_close_file does this before the RefusedModified return. In render, after the EditorSurface child, add .child(div().text_color(self.colors.foreground).child(self.notice.clone().unwrap_or_default())). An empty string is the child when notice is None. Leave files.rs unchanged. file_effect_line already returns the sentences. This packet does not enable the gpui-tests feature. Add mod notice_tests with an_open_failure_keeps_a_sentence. OpenFailed stores The file could not be opened. SaveFailed stores The save failed. Ready stores None. NeedsPath stores This document has no path. AlreadyOpen stores Another document has that path. UnknownView stores The view is not open. RefusedModified stores None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep this change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: session::notice_tests::an_open_failure_keeps_a_sentence
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because remember_effect does not exist. OpenFailed, SaveFailed, NeedsPath, AlreadyOpen, and UnknownView store their sentences. Ready and RefusedModified store None. The test builds on macOS.
